5. Loss of eyebrows and eyelashes beginning at age 2 years.
6. History of blisters on anterior shins following minor trauma since age 12 years.
7. Recurrent episodes of urinary retention due to severe strictures of bulbar urethra, requiring urethroplasties.
9. Absent eyebrows and eyelashes on physical examination.
10. Erythematous atrophic patches on anterior shins on physical examination.
11. Confined collections of milia on physical examination.
ground_truth_exam_facts: 4. Skin Biopsy Finding: Subepidermal split with collagen IV staining.
5. Electron Microscopy finding: Sublamina densa blister with discontinuous basement membrane.
6. Electron Microscopy finding: lamina densa and hemidesmosomes on roof.
7. Electron Microscopy finding: collagen bundles at dermal base.
8. Immunofluorescence Studies: Integrin α3: Mislocalized and lower-intensity staining.
9. Immunofluorescence Studies: Integrin β1: Normal expression.
10. Immunofluorescence Studies: Collagen XVII: Normal expression.
11. Whole-exome sequencing revealed homozygous variant c.821G>A (p.R274Q) in ITGA3 gene.

Diagnosis 1: Integrin α3 (ITGA3)–related epidermolysis bullosa / ILNEB (integrin α3 deficiency) — most likely -> Score 2
Diagnosis 2: Dystrophic epidermolysis bullosa (COL7A1-related) -> Score 1
Diagnosis 3: Kindler syndrome (FERMT1-related) -> Score 1
Diagnosis 4: Epidermolysis bullosa acquisita (autoimmune anti–type VII collagen) -> Score 1
